name: liqology
description: A liquid ontology platform: disambiguates entities via FAISS vector search, groups them into neuron-connectable buckets, and refines bucket relationships via a liquid neural net (parallelizable Euler-discretized liquid time-constant update). Built on a C++23 boilerplate closing the ergonomic gap with Rust: typed Result<T,E>, GSL ownership, deterministic packaging, sanitizer-gated CI, wasip1 + native cross-compilation.
